list.name: building
list.label: Building
list.query: SELECT code AS __text, id AS __value FROM building ORDER BY code

panels.title: Portfolio load
panels.description: Hourly mean across every building, read from the continuous aggregate rather than the raw hypertable.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, sum(avg_kw) AS "portfolio kW" FROM reading_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM reading

panels.title: Buildings costed against measurement
panels.description: F3: how many buildings the optimizer prices using forecast-derived consumption rather than the figure the portfolio fixture shipped with.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE annual_kwh_source = 'forecast') AS value FROM building

panels.title: Selected building — actual vs forecast
panels.description: The residual between these two is what the anomaly detector scores.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, avg_kw AS actual FROM reading_hourly WHERE building_id = '$building' AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY bucket
SELECT ts AS time, yhat AS forecast FROM forecast WHERE building_id = '$building' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Forecaster in use
panels.description: The learned model is kept only where it beats a seasonal-naive baseline on held-out data. A large baseline share means the load is close to perfectly weekly, which is information rather than a failure.

targets.rawSql: SELECT model_version AS metric, count(DISTINCT building_id) AS value FROM forecast GROUP BY model_version

panels.title: Anomalies flagged
panels.description: Hourly flags, not alerts: consecutive flags are one incident.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS time, severity AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM anomaly WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT b.code AS building, a.ts, round(a.observed_kw::numeric, 1) AS observed_kw, round(a.expected_kw::numeric, 1) AS expected_kw, round(a.robust_z::numeric, 1) AS z, a.severity FROM anomaly a JOIN building b ON b.id = a.building_id WHERE NOT a.acknowledged ORDER BY abs(a.robust_z) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 25

panels.title: Recent allocations
panels.description: Every stored optimization run, with the inputs hash that produced it — so a recommendation can be traced back to the catalog and consumption figures it was costed against.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at, solver, objective, status, budget_egp, round(total_cost_egp::numeric, 0) AS spent_egp, buildings_funded, round(total_benefit_kgco2e::numeric, 0) AS lifetime_kgco2e, round(solve_ms::numeric, 0) AS solve_ms, left(inputs_hash, 12) AS inputs FROM optimization_run ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20
